title: Commission dashboard
description: Review commission ledger activity and reconciliation batch status. Export each batch as a complete authenticated CSV snapshot for payout reconciliation.
missingApiConfig: The frontend API connection is not configured.
signInRequired: Sign in to view commission data.
restricted: Only OWNER or ADMIN accounts can view the full commission ledger and reconciliation data.
loadFailed: Commission data could not be loaded from the API.
firstPageNote: The dashboard loads up to the first 100 ledger rows and 100 reconciliation batches. API totals remain authoritative; batch CSV exports are generated from the complete server-side reconciliation snapshot.
minorUnitNote: Amounts are displayed as integer minor units with their currency code to avoid implicit rounding.

ledger.title: Commission ledger
ledger.caption: Commission transaction list
ledger.empty: No transactions match the current filters.

exportFailed: The reconciliation export could not be downloaded.

workflow.title: Reconciliation workflow
workflow.description: Choose a stakeholder payout date, select eligible accrued transactions, create an immutable payout batch, then export or mark it paid.
workflow.payoutDateHint: Day 5 reconciles interview-invited commission; day 15 reconciles worked-30-days commission.
workflow.eligibleHint: {count} loaded transactions match {milestone}. Select rows from one currency only.
workflow.choosePayoutDate: Choose a valid payout date on day 5 or 15.
workflow.noEligible: No loaded accrued transactions match this payout class.
workflow.currencyMismatch: Selected transactions must use one currency. Remove rows from other currencies before creating the batch.
workflow.createFailed: The reconciliation batch could not be created. Check payout date, transaction state, milestone and currency.
workflow.confirmPaid: Mark this reconciliation batch as paid? This changes all linked BATCHED ledger rows to PAID.
workflow.payFailed: The batch could not be marked paid because its ledger snapshot no longer matches or another change won the race.
